Quest name: Shapeshifting of a Young Maiden (Chrono Quest - Mythical Era)
Quest location: Athens Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r2 Recognition, r4 Astronomy, r3 Theology
Pre-requisite discovery: The Big Dipper discovery (from "The Polestar and the Ladle" quest) + The Statue of Artemis discovery (from "Statue of the moon goddess" quest)
